current_app_protection: Nothing in pmp-app-current.html -> pmp-current-map.json -> pmp-current-inner-cleanbug-v1.html -> pmp-home-single-v6.html may be removed.
conflict_policy: If any classification conflicts with these gates, the gates win and cleanup is blocked.
hard_rules: No deletion without a change proposal.
No deletion without archive-first path and cooling period.
No deletion unless dependency proof is NO_DEPENDENCY_FOUND.
No deletion unless extraction state is SAFE_TO_DELETE.
No deletion of safety, recovery, privacy, vault, current route, or active support files.
No deletion without restore drill proof.
No deletion without explicit user approval after proposal review.
cooling_period_rule: No same-day archive-to-delete jump for any file with history, route, remodel, safety, privacy, or memory value.
